svg.text: AD5M | EBB36 and bed-breakout photo overlay
Original photos preserved. Connector zones are identified; no hidden or unreadable pin positions are invented.
EBB36 CAN V1.2.1 / FRONT AS PHOTOGRAPHED
Four-contact power / CAN connector
24 V -> VIN; DC ground -> GND.
CAN H -> H; CAN L -> L.
Exact contact positions remain unassigned.
Extruder motor
Use the angled four-pin connector at upper left.
Pair motor coils before assigning contacts.
Hotend heater
Green screw terminal -> X1C heater pair.
Heater element has no polarity.
Temperature and fans: identify headers by labels
TH0 / PA3 -> separate X1C thermistor wires.
Fan channel PA0 -> two-wire hotend fan (VIN and switched -).
Four-wire blower PWM interface still needs resolution.
X and Y Hall sensors
5 V supply; GND; separate signal outputs.
Signals need pull-ups to 3.3 V.
Sensor legs and EBB input contacts pending.
BED BREAKOUT / CONNECTOR SIDE
Breakout mapping from the reference conversion
1-11 together -> ReliaBot HOT BED negative.
12-22 together -> ReliaBot HOT BED positive.
29 and 30 separately -> Octopus TB pair (no polarity).
23 -> Octopus 5 V; 28 -> Octopus ground.
26 -> compatible Octopus probe input, contact pending.
24, 25 and 27 -> unused in this reference arrangement.
Header numbering, not wire colors, defines these routes.
Photo does not expose each individual solder joint.
KEY: red = +24 V gray = DC ground purple = USB blue = load/sensor teal = CAN amber dashed = pending
Photo overlays are a draft connection reference. Check terminal markings and unresolved interfaces before assembly.
